findings.text: `_append_comment` (reckon/mcp_edit_plan.py:136-181, exported as `reckon.mcp._append_comment` and listed among the run-scoped plan-state writers in tests/test_plan_reads_stay_in_the_worktree.py:196) appends `data.comments[section_id]` and calls only `_run_scoped_write_guard` before `write_plan` — no authored-body check at all — so a comment posted through it still carries `go to a follow-up node` while the identical body posted through the `append` op is refused, which is exactly the write/audit disagreement §3 exists to close ("It keeps its one reader, so the audit warning and the store refusal widen together" holds for the regex but not for coverage)
